lines.text: I'm not upset. I'm just writing it all down.
Pull over whenever you're ready. I'll wait.
You have the right to a very long ferry wait.
No rush. Neither of us makes that ferry.
Let's get you somewhere dry. Then jail.

meta.notes: region-pnw (playtest 1c). Agent drafts that stay until vetoed.

voice.model: ResembleAI/chatterbox (MIT), via fal on Hugging Face Inference Providers
voice.reference: hexgrad/Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0) voice am_echo, speed 0.85, pitch -2 semitones; synthetic, no real person's voice

review.method: Every clip transcribed on the dev machine's GPU by Whisper large-v3-turbo and large-v3, plus pitch, pace, level and a speaker-similarity check (WavLM) against the rival's other clips (tools/voices/scripts/check_local.py). Garbled (both checks heard other words) or off-voice clips were redone free with Kokoro-82M on the GPU in the rival's reference voice (tools/voices/scripts/redo_local.py); everything else was kept.
